caption: The drawing depicts a single brass or gold-colored oil lamp centrally positioned on a plain, beige background. The lamp consists of an egg-shaped fuel reservoir with two cylindrical openings or spouts at the top. The reservoir is mounted on a short, narrow stem that widens into a round base, connecting to a flat, circular tray or plate. The plate supports the entire structure and is rendered in similar brass tones with highlights and shaded areas indicating the reflective surface. A curved, upright handle with a finger loop is attached to the edge of the plate. The drawing is signed "David S. DeVault" in the lower right corner. There are no additional objects or decorative elements present in the composition.
title: Sperm Oil Lamp
